prompt: Add a new 'Feature Importance' tab to Model Evaluation page showing top-20 LightGBM importances as a horizontal bar chart using house chart style.

assertions.name: adds tab_fi variable
assertions.text: Code includes a new tab variable (e.g. tab_fi) in the st.tabs() call

assertions.name: uses go.Bar horizontal
assertions.text: Chart uses go.Bar with orientation='h' or plotly horizontal bar

assertions.name: width='stretch' not use_container_width
assertions.text: plotly_chart call uses width='stretch', not use_container_width=True

assertions.name: no plt introduced
assertions.text: Solution does not import matplotlib.pyplot or call plt.subplots / st.pyplot
